name: reethink
description: Six skills that make an AI coding agent check before it answers and say what it found in a way a person can act on.

interface.shortDescription: Check before you answer, and say what you found.
interface.longDescription: Four skills decide what is true: check the source, check whether it is still true, keep the code workable, and judge what is worth building. Two more decide what survives the trip to the reader: the answer first with every measured number kept, and plain writing that keeps the real names and identifiers. Measured against a baseline, it did not make answers more often right; it made them checkable.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check this against the source before you answer.
